_meta.purpose: Generic US-national defaults for region-scoped parameters (Phase 1.12.2b). A region bundle that OMITS a bucket-2 parameter inherits the value here and the importer WARNS. These are honest national placeholders, NOT a substitute for local data — replace them with your market's figures. The MA reference (regions/salem_reference_v2) supplies its own values explicitly and does not use these.
_meta.tiers: cited = a stable, dated national statistic; reasoned-proxy = a defensible national stand-in where no direct statistic for the exact concept exists.
_meta.fred_window: Seasonality + DaysOnMarket_Mean computed from FRED national series over 2023-01..2025-12 (36 monthly obs, post the Oct-2022 Realtor.com methodology break), month-average / overall-average — the same method as the Salem/Essex calibration.

required._note: Bucket 1 — no honest national generic. The importer REFUSES a bundle that omits any of these.

INC.EarnerMedianAnnual.means: median individual-earner annual income for the local renter pool
INC.EarnerMedianAnnual.source_hint: US Census ACS table B25119 (renter-occupied) for your area

OPEX.PropertyTaxPerUnit.source_hint: your municipality's residential rate x per-unit assessed value

national_defaults_scalar._note: Bucket 2 — applied with a warning if the bundle omits them.

MARKET.DaysOnMarket_Mean.source: FRED MEDDAYONMARUS (Median Days on Market, US), 2023-2025 average
MARKET.DaysOnMarket_Mean.means: mean days a listing sits before it sells or is withdrawn
MARKET.DaysOnMarket_Mean.direction: higher = slower market-wide resolution = slower acquisition throughput / capital deployment

PROP.VacancyRateBase.source: RealPage / NMHC professionally-managed multifamily occupancy ~94.3-95.4% (2024-Q3 2025); vacancy ~5%. No direct national statistic for a well-run operator's OWN vacancy; this proxies it and sits below the ~7% market aggregate as the concept requires.
PROP.VacancyRateBase.means: the operator's OWN steady-state vacancy (below market because units are desirable)
PROP.VacancyRateBase.direction: higher = less rent collected at any time = more conservative revenue

RET.VacancyRefPct.source: US rental vacancy rate, Census Housing Vacancy Survey (FRED RRVRUSQ156N), ~7.0% (Q2 2025; 7.3% Q2 2026)
RET.VacancyRefPct.means: the balanced-market rental vacancy used to normalize scarcity (availability = regional_vacancy / this)
RET.VacancyRefPct.direction: higher = any given regional vacancy reads as less available = more scarcity = higher retention via the scarcity channel

RET.MoverRegionalVacancyPct.source: No national analog to a local tightening story; defaulted equal to the national balanced-market rate (RET.VacancyRefPct). Census HVS Q2 2026 alt: principal-cities 8.0% / suburbs 6.9% if an urban/suburban lean is wanted.
RET.MoverRegionalVacancyPct.means: the wider-metro rental vacancy a LEAVING tenant faces when searching
RET.MoverRegionalVacancyPct.direction: higher = more alternatives for a leaver = weaker scarcity lock-in = more turnover

INF.Surge_PropertyMean.source: S&P CoreLogic Case-Shiller US National HPI, calendar-year gains 2020 +10.4% / 2021 +18.8% / 2022 +5.8%, CAGR ~11.5% -> 0.12
INF.Surge_PropertyMean.means: annual property-value growth during a 'surge' inflation regime
INF.Surge_PropertyMean.direction: higher = acquisitions cost more in surge years (faster appreciation of owned stock too)

INF.Surge_OpExMean.source: S&P Global Market Intelligence homeowners/property insurance, +46.8% cumulative 2020-2025 (CAGR ~8%); 0.07 as the conservative blended-OpEx figure (insurance is the fastest line; tax/R&M lag)
INF.Surge_OpExMean.means: annual operating-expense growth during a 'surge' regime (insurance-anchored blend)
INF.Surge_OpExMean.direction: higher = OpEx erodes margin faster in surge years = more cash/CSF stress

national_defaults_monthly._note: Bucket 2 — 12-month seasonal indices (mean ~1.0). Each expands to <base>_Jan .. <base>_Dec registry rows. Cited: FRED national series, 2023-2025, month-avg/overall-avg (Salem method).

MARKET.SeasonalMultiplier.source: FRED ACTLISCOUUS (Active Listing Count, US), 2023-2025 seasonal index
MARKET.SeasonalMultiplier.means: monthly index of new-listing / active-inventory volume
MARKET.SeasonalMultiplier.direction: higher month = more acquisition opportunities appear that month

MARKET.DaysOnMarket_SeasonalMultiplier.source: FRED MEDDAYONMARUS (Median Days on Market, US), 2023-2025 seasonal index
MARKET.DaysOnMarket_SeasonalMultiplier.means: monthly index of how long listings sit
MARKET.DaysOnMarket_SeasonalMultiplier.direction: higher month = listings around then take longer to resolve

MARKET.PriceMultiplier.source: FRED MEDLISPRIUS (Median Listing Price, US), 2023-2025 seasonal index
MARKET.PriceMultiplier.direction: higher month = properties acquired then cost more

universal_shipped._note: Bucket 3 — universal modeling assumptions that ship with the engine; NOT region-specific, not in a bundle. Listed for transparency.
